name: Awesome Design MD
hook: 57 brand design systems (Apple, Stripe, Notion, Airbnb, Anthropic/Claude, and 52 more) encoded as plain DESIGN.md files — drop one into any project and Claude Code generates brand-accurate UI without design tokens or Figma exports. Hit 95.6K GitHub stars organically, making it one of the fastest-climbing repos in the Claude ecosystem.
install: See README — download individual DESIGN.md files or clone and copy into your project root

name: PAUL — Plan-Apply-Unify Loop
hook: Structured 3-phase Claude Code skill: Plan (Claude drafts acceptance criteria and waits for explicit approval), Apply (builds only what was approved, no freelancing), Unify (reconciles plan vs. built). 1.1K stars. Charlie Automates called PAUL + SEED "the meta nobody's talking about" — PAUL alone prevents the drift that compounds over long agentic sessions.

name: SEED — AI Project Incubator
hook: Type-aware guided ideation skill for Claude Code that takes a raw idea through a structured exploration and produces a PAUL-ready build plan. SEED and PAUL are designed as a pair: SEED structures what to build, PAUL structures how to build it without context drift. 298 stars; featured alongside PAUL and Skillsmith by Charlie Automates as a complete "Chris AI stack."

name: Skillsmith
hook: End-to-end framework for building standardized Claude Code skills — defines 7 file types with syntax specs, then provides four workflows: Discover (questionnaire → spec), Scaffold (spec → compliant directory), Distill (books/transcripts → framework chunks), Audit (compliance report). 119 stars; SEED itself was built with Skillsmith, making it the meta-framework behind the Chris AI stack.

name: Claude for Foundation Models (Swift)
hook: Official Anthropic Swift package (v0.1.0, Apache-2.0) that plugs Claude into Apple's Foundation Models framework. iOS/macOS/visionOS/watchOS 27 apps use the same LanguageModelSession API for Claude as for Apple's on-device model — streaming, guided generation, and tool calling all work identically. Requests go directly to Anthropic; Apple is not in the request path.
install: Add via Xcode: File ▸ Add Package Dependencies… → https://github.com/anthropics/ClaudeForFoundationModels.git

name: Enterprise-Managed Auth for MCP Connectors
hook: Anthropic's zero-touch MCP provisioning for enterprises: IT admins authorize connectors once through Okta, employees inherit access the first time they open Claude — no OAuth queues, no per-user consent. Seven connectors at launch: Asana, Atlassian (Jira/Confluence/Rovo), Canva, Figma, Granola, Linear, Supabase. Ramp has 2,000 employees live. Works in Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork.

name: Parallel Code
hook: Desktop app (macOS/Linux) that dispatches Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini agents simultaneously, each in its own isolated git worktree. Built-in diff viewer with inline comments, per-task shell terminals, steps tracking panel, PR CI status notifications, and 10 themes. 814 stars. Automates the parallel-worktree pattern that IndyDevDan's "How I PARALLELIZE Claude Code" video popularized, without any manual shell setup.
install: Download .dmg (macOS) or .AppImage/.deb (Linux) from GitHub releases page

name: Claude Code Best Practice
hook: Living cheat sheet for Claude Code covering CLAUDE.md patterns, skills, subagents, hooks, and slash commands — "from vibe coding to agentic engineering." Grew from 18.5K stars in March to 57K+ stars now, trending on GitHub with active daily updates. Frequently cited in community posts as the starting point for Claude Code configuration.

name: Claude Code Ultimate Guide
hook: 430K+ line educational repo: 181 production-ready templates (23 agents, 74 skills, 37 hooks), 48 Mermaid architecture diagrams, and a 271-question quiz with 4 skill profiles. Security section tracks 28 CVEs and 655 known-malicious skills. 5.3K stars. Available as an MCP server for in-session access, or one claude command to onboard. Templates under CC0 (free to copy).
install: claude "Fetch and follow the onboarding instructions from: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide/main/tools/onboarding-prompt.md"
